北京.name: 北京
北京.ai_briefing_zh: 北京阴天高温，风力不小，注意防暑防风哦！
北京.ai_briefing_en: Beijing is overcast and hot with strong winds. Stay cool and protect from wind!
北京.alert: 🟧 橙色降温提示：1小时降温3℃

慈溪.name: 慈溪
慈溪.ai_briefing_zh: 慈溪风力 6级，多云炎热，务必注意防风防晒！
慈溪.ai_briefing_en: Cixi has strong 6-level winds and is cloudy and hot. Be sure to protect from wind and sun!

上海.name: 上海
上海.ai_briefing_zh: 上海艳阳高照，体感超热，记得多补充水分！
上海.ai_briefing_en: Shanghai is sunny and feels extremely hot. Remember to hydrate well!

广州.name: 广州
广州.ai_briefing_zh: 广州高温热浪，体感直逼 39℃，注意防中暑！
广州.ai_briefing_en: Guangzhou is experiencing a heatwave, feeling close to 39℃. Watch out for heatstroke!

深圳.name: 深圳
深圳.ai_briefing_zh: 深圳阳光正好，体感 35℃，外出记得防晒哦！
深圳.ai_briefing_en: Shenzhen is sunny and feels 35℃. Don't forget sunscreen if you go out!

杭州.name: 杭州
杭州.ai_briefing_zh: 杭州多云高温，风力 6级较大，外出注意安全！
杭州.ai_briefing_en: Hangzhou is cloudy and hot with strong 6-level winds. Be careful when going out!

南京.name: 南京
南京.ai_briefing_zh: 南京多云高温，体感 35℃，小心别中暑哦！
南京.ai_briefing_en: Nanjing is cloudy and hot, feeling 35℃. Be careful not to get heatstroke!

成都.name: 成都
成都.ai_briefing_zh: 成都体感 36℃，紫外线强，防晒和补水要做好！
成都.ai_briefing_en: Chengdu feels 36℃ with strong UV. Remember sun protection and hydration!

武汉.name: 武汉
武汉.ai_briefing_zh: 武汉大雨且高温，风力不小，出门记得带伞注意安全！
武汉.ai_briefing_en: Wuhan has heavy rain and high temperatures with strong winds. Remember your umbrella and stay safe!

西安.name: 西安
西安.ai_briefing_zh: 西安多云，体感 34℃，天气炎热，注意防晒！
西安.ai_briefing_en: Xi'an is cloudy and feels 34℃. It's hot, so remember sun protection!

重庆.name: 重庆
重庆.ai_briefing_zh: 重庆阴天，天气闷热，及时补充水分防止中暑！
重庆.ai_briefing_en: Chongqing is overcast and muggy. Hydrate regularly to prevent heatstroke!
重庆.alert: 📉 红色降温预警：1小时骤降5℃ | 💨 北风警报：北风 4级

哈尔滨.name: 哈尔滨
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_zh: 哈尔滨晴朗凉爽，风力 5级，早晚温差大注意保暖！
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_en: Harbin is sunny and cool with 5-level winds. Mind the temperature difference between day and night!

沈阳.name: 沈阳
沈阳.ai_briefing_zh: 沈阳晴天，风力 6级，出门注意防风，小心着凉！
沈阳.ai_briefing_en: Shenyang is sunny with 6-level winds. Be mindful of the wind when going out, don't catch a cold!

昆明.name: 昆明
昆明.ai_briefing_zh: 昆明阴天湿冷，湿度 93%，出门记得添衣保暖哦！
昆明.ai_briefing_en: Kunming is overcast, cold, and humid at 93%. Remember to layer up and stay warm!

厦门.name: 厦门
厦门.ai_briefing_zh: 厦门多云闷热，风力 5级，注意防潮防暑补水！
厦门.ai_briefing_en: Xiamen is cloudy and muggy with 5-level winds. Mind the humidity, heat, and hydrate!
厦门.alert: 📉 红色降温预警：1小时骤降5℃

青岛.name: 青岛
青岛.ai_briefing_zh: 青岛多云，体感 33℃，湿度较高，注意防暑降温！
青岛.ai_briefing_en: Qingdao is cloudy and feels 33℃ with high humidity. Stay cool and prevent heatstroke!

大连.name: 大连
大连.ai_briefing_zh: 大连晴天，气温 33℃，风力不小，记得多补水！
大连.ai_briefing_en: Dalian is sunny and 33℃ with strong winds. Remember to hydrate well!
